verdict.rationale: Airweave can be driven by natural language mainly through external AI agents. Its official skills let agents in Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI and similar tools set up integrations and search data without step-by-step instructions. Its MCP server lets AI assistants search synced data, and its agentic search mode handles natural-language queries with iterative tool calling. However, the evidence shows no first-party natural-language command interface, and NL operation of management tasks beyond setup and search is not documented. missing for 10: a native NL console or command interface within the product, documented NL coverage of collection/sync management beyond setup and search, independent hands-on corroboration of NL-driven operation.
